Vazhushal (also spelled Vazhishal) is a rummy game that originated in Chennai (Tamil Nadu) and is very popular in southern India. The Tamil name means 'Wipe', referring to the distinctive rule that players may take more than one card from the discard line. It differs from Indian Rummy played further north by allowing this 'wiping' of the discard line, similar to the Western game Rummy 500.
52 cards + jokers. A high or low (no wrap).
13 each. Discard LINE (spread out, all visible).

items.text: No negative joker: Two-player game sometimes played without a negative joker; only printed jokers are wild, making melding harder.
Three players with one deck: Three people may play with one deck (only 13 cards in stock after deal); variant limits discard line to 10 cards, moving excess to bottom of stock.
